text: Hey, adventurer. Nice weather today.\n...What? You wanna buy this land?\nThat's just what I was hoping for.
Well, actually, I was having a hard time selling\nthe land. How much, you ask? Let me see...\nHow about [ffff64]10,000 Spinas?[ffffff]
Okay, deal! Thanks! You've got a good deal.\nIt won't let you down.
Oh, I almost forgot. Sometimes monsters stray\ninto here, so can you drive them off by yourself?\nThere's nothing I can do about it.
From now, you can build your house and rooms.\nAlso, [ffff64]you can have pets[ffffff]!
Open [Menu] and tap [[64ffff]Partition Settings[ffffff]] to make\nyour rooms.
Stray monsters may visit your land if you keep\nsome spaces for them to enter the land.
Uh-oh. Looks like you're short of cash.\nYou don't need to hurry. Get Spinas and come to\nsee me again. I'll be here.
...Oh, yea? It's a good deal I guess...\nWell, okay. Come again if you change your mind.\nI'll be here.
